If you and your colleague both upload a file called `quote.pdf`, the second upload will overwrite the first one. The first file will be lost because the system uses the filename as a key, and duplicate filenames overwrite each other.

To avoid this, give each file a unique name — for example, `quote_john.pdf` and `quote_sarah.pdf`. That way, both files will be preserved and visible in the system.
